ezinsar.eicomponents.jobmodule.jobproctools

module documentation
(source)

Module to manage an EZ-InSAR processing job

The module allows to add some tools to manage an EZ-InSAR processing job: i.e., checking.

(From ezinsar package)

Function check Check a EZ-InSAR processing job
def check(job, verbose: bool | None = None, mode: str | None = 'low'): (source) ¶

Check a EZ-InSAR processing job

The function checks the parameters of an EZ-InSAR processing job.

Parameters
job:EIjobEZ-InSAR job
verbose:boolverbose [Default: None]. If None, the function will use the value from the EIjob job.
mode:strmode of checking [Default: low]. Can be low``or ``high.
